newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela CANTV may dismiss another 1,000 workers.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela CANTV may dismiss another 1,000 workers.

text.p: Venezuelan telephone company CANTV may lay-off a thousand workers throughout the country in addition to the 400 it said late Thursday would be dismissed in the central Federal District and Miranda states.

Thursday's announcement, although authorized by a tri-partite commission that groups the company with the telephone workers union Fetratel, provoked immediate protest from CANTV workers who threatened to strike.

"CANTV has sacked over 400 workers as its Christmas present," said a press release from the Federal District and Miranda State Union of Telephone Workers. The release added that industrial action would be taken next week unless the decision was reversed.
CANTV vice president Alvaro Benavides meanwhile said in an interview on Radio Caracas that the company "had strictly adhered to the law".
"While I understand some union leaders may disagree with the decision, any action (on their part) that halted the company's activities would be illegal," he said.
Benavides said labor-shedding due to technological upgrades would be extended through the country and that up to another thousand workers could be dismissed.
Labor Minister Juan Neponucemo Garrido said he would discuss the issue with CANTV directors next week after meeting with union officials Friday morning.
